title: Pic proper curve cokernel component
statement: Let C be a proper smooth connected dimension-one curve over an algebraically closed field k [def-sc-curves], with genus g [def-sc-genus], Picard group Pic(C) [def-sc-picard-group], and degree-zero subgroup Pic⁰(C) [def-sc-pic0]. Let n be a natural number whose image in k is nonzero. Then Pic(C) modulo the image of multiplication by n is isomorphic as a group to ℤ/nℤ.

proof.text: Forward-port the canonical upstream Scheme.nonempty_addEquiv_torsionBy_pic_and_quotient interface, absent from the pinned library. Its torsion clause follows from lem-sc-pic-proper-ntorsion-torsion by the power-kernel/additive-torsion equivalence; its divisibility clause follows from lem-sc-pic-proper-ntorsion-div and the equality of picardZero with the degree-zero kernel.

Install f as the structure morphism of C. Connectedness, local Noetherianity and smooth regularity give irreducibility, so the dimension-one hypothesis gives smooth relative dimension one. Set d = Scheme.picDegreeHom k C. Use Scheme.surjective_picDegreeHom, the degree-surjectivity part of lem-sc-pic-proper-decomposition, directly; the full splitting and a product equivalence are unnecessary. Scheme.coe_ker_picDegreeHom identifies the carrier of the degree kernel with f.picZero.

Compose d with integer cast into Multiplicative (ZMod n). Both maps are surjective, so their composite phi is surjective. Its kernel is the nth-power image. An nth power vanishes modulo n. Conversely, if phi L is the identity, write (d L).toAdd = n*z using ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd. By degree surjectivity choose M of degree z. Then L / M^n has degree zero. Use pic_proper_ntorsion_div to choose R with R^n = L / M^n. The class R*M has nth power L by commutativity and cancellation. The first isomorphism theorem, after changing the subgroup by equality, gives the desired quotient equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.nonempty_addEquiv_torsionBy_pic_and_quotient
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    [C.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsProper (C ↘ Spec (.of k))] [ConnectedSpace C]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : (n : k) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (AddSubgroup.torsionBy (Additive C.Pic) n ≃+
        (Fin (2 * (C ↘ Spec (.of k)).genus) → ZMod n)) ∧
      Nonempty (Additive C.Pic ⧸ (zsmulAddGroupHom (α := Additive C.Pic) n).range ≃+
        ZMod n) ∧
      Function.Surjective fun L : picardZero k C ↦ L ^ n
